QuestInfo.name: [Evolution System] Left Behind
QuestInfo.1: Claudine in Edelstein told you about the incident in Gelimer's Basement Laboratory.
QuestInfo.2: Claudine in Edelstein told you about the incident in Gelimer's Basement Laboratory.

1.0: My people have made a startling discovery in the mines. That old coot, Gelimer, seems to have kidnapped Lotus from Orchid. I'm not sure why, but it has to be something involving the Black Mage.
1.1: Checky found Orchid unconscious in the lab and took her into custody, but she hasn't put up any kind of a fight. She seems to have lost her powers entirely.
1.2: I've been attempting to stabilize her enough to get some answers, but her condition has been difficult to manage. She's going to need some time before she can face punishment for her crimes. Seeing her like this, it's hard to imagine that she was one of our most fearsome enemies.
1.3: For now, we should focus on Gelimer. That lab has to hold some clues as to what he's up to.
